methodology.correction: Initial-day published 選抜 is 初日特選 (verified against independent race programs for Yokkaichi G3, Kawasaki F1, Aomori F1, Takeo F1). On later days 選抜 is loser-side.
methodology.distinction: Special selection races after initial day are in 特選等, never indiscriminately grouped as loser races.
methodology.unchanged: Same race IDs, same 8 engine tickets and stakes/payouts, no re-generation and no outcome-based selection.
methodology.caution: 833-race prospective-of-categories research sample, retrospective current-code historical replay, NOT 1-year engine backtest.
